description: Tooling or infrastructure, and the profile for work that makes no capability claim at all - which is why a TASK has somewhere to land. The capability-chain criteria are NOT_APPLICABLE with a stated reason rather than quietly omitted, because the distinction between 'this does not apply' and 'we did not check' is the one this whole model exists to keep.

not_applicable_by_default.reason: work making no capability claim owns no canonical entity
there is no source or data contract to specify
there is no writer-reader chain to connect
no value crosses a persistence boundary
there is no capability for an operator to observe working
there is no capability chain to trace a real record through
there is no surface to exercise
there is no user-visible outcome to state or to learn about
